basic_details.scholarship_name: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) International Graduate Fellowship & Research Assistantship
basic_details.offering_entity: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) & POSCO Foundation, South Korea
basic_details.major_restrictions: Department of Physics, Department of Chemistry, Department of Life Sciences, Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Department of Chemical Engineering, Department of Electronic and Electrical Engineering, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Graduate School of Artificial Intelligence, and Division of Advanced Nuclear Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 180 international graduate fellowships awarded annually across departments
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally; typically 15 to 25 Pakistani STEM and informatics researchers selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 4 semesters (2 years) for Master's; 6 to 8 semesters (3 to 4 years) for PhD; 10 semesters (5 years) for Combined MS/PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: Combined tuition waiver and research assistantship: 100% full tuition covered plus KRW 1,100,000 to 1,500,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 231,000 to 315,000 / month) and KRW 1,500,000 to 2,100,000 / month for PhD (~PKR 315,000 to 441,000 / month)

nationality_requirements: International applicants whose parents both hold non-Korean citizenship (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory maximum age limit, though priority is given to young researchers with exceptional academic momentum.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.30/4.00 for Master's; recognized 18-year Master's degree with minimum CGPA 3.30/4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.30 / 4.00; competitive applicants at POSTECH typically possess CGPA >= 3.65 / 4.00 or top 5-10% class rank.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, artificial intelligence, electrical engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, physics, chemistry, or life sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree requirements before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals (SCI/SCIE) or top conferences (IEEE, ACM) provide a substantial competitive edge.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 79, TOEIC 750+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited university.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Korean language proficiency is not required; all graduate courses, seminars, and research are conducted in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: All admitted international graduate students are automatically considered for the POSTECH Fellowship and laboratory assistantship package upon faculty recommendation.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another parallel government fellowship covering identical living and tuition benefits.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver covering all standard degree semesters at POSTECH.

admission_application_fee.details: Online application fee of USD 80 (or KRW 80,000) paid via credit card on the POSTECH admissions portal.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitory housing in Pohang (DICE / Graduate Student Apartments; approx. KRW 120,000 to 200,000 / month), paid easily from living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Combined institutional fellowship and laboratory research assistantship: KRW 1,100,000 to 1,500,000 / month for Master's; KRW 1,500,000 to 2,100,000 / month for PhD.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Busan/Seoul Incheon International Airport is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: South Korean D-2 Student Visa fee paid directly to the Korean Embassy in Islamabad.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory enrollment in Korea National Health Insurance Service (NHIS); subsidized monthly premium (approx. KRW 70,000 / month) paid from stipend.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized on-campus student cafeterias (Jigok Community Center and Student Hall); meals cost KRW 4,000 to 6,500.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to POSTECH Tae-Joon Park Digital Library, Pohang Light Source (PLS-II synchrotron facility), and Max Planck Korea Research Initiative laboratories.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: 100% covered synchrotron and laboratory infrastructure access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Laboratory research grants and POSCO Foundation funds cover international conference registration, travel, and accommodation for accepted papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized KTX high-speed train transit to Seoul (Pohang KTX Station connects directly to Seoul Station in 2.2 hours).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single South Korea elite private research institute (POSTECH, Pohang).
participating_institutions: Pohang University of Science and Technology (Pohang Campus, Gyeongsangbuk-do, South Korea)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #98 globally, World Top 30 in Materials Science, Top 5 in South Korea; recognized as the 'Caltech of Asia' with an ultra-low student-to-faculty ratio (3:1).
available_majors: Master's / PhD in Materials Science and Engineering
Master's / PhD in Computer Science and Engineering
Master's / PhD in Graduate School of Artificial Intelligence
Master's / PhD in Electronic and Electrical Engineering
Master's / PhD in Physics and Chemistry
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years; Combined MS/PhD: 5 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with CGPA >= 3.30/4.00, academic transcripts, statement of purpose, two recommendation letters, English test score (IELTS 6.0+ / TOEFL 79+ / MOI), and CV.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Graduate School of AI, Computer Science, and Materials Science are fiercely competitive; contacting professors prior to applying significantly increases admission and RA funding odds.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Review recent publications from POSTECH faculty laboratories, particularly those connected to the Pohang Light Source or POSCO battery and semiconductor projects, and send a targeted research query.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the POSTECH admissions portal, complete online application form, upload personal statement and transcripts, pay USD 80 fee, and dispatch certified physical documents to POSTECH Admissions Office.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Contact prospective POSTECH professors in target research areas with CV and research interests (July-August for Spring / December-January for Fall).
Step 2: Register on POSTECH Graduate Admissions Online System during open intake.
Step 3: Complete online application, upload documents, and pay USD 80 fee.
Step 4: Register two academic recommenders who submit evaluation letters online.
Step 5: Send certified hard-copy documents (degrees, transcripts, apostille/attestation) via DHL to POSTECH Admissions Office in Pohang.
Step 6: Departmental faculty committee reviews dossiers and conducts virtual technical interviews.
Step 7: Final admission and scholarship award results announced online.
Step 8: Obtain Certificate of Admission (CoA), apply for South Korean D-2 visa, and arrive in Pohang.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Institutional Route: Admission and scholarship funding are decided together based on departmental faculty recommendation.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two academic recommenders via confidential portal links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Personal Statement and Research Plan (prescribed POSTECH format) describing motivation, research experiences, scholarly interests, and post-graduation goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research plan detailing proposed technical investigations, methodologies, and alignment with target POSTECH laboratories.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic research CV detailing education, laboratory proficiencies, software skills, and publication history.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental faculty panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 79+, TOEIC 750+, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan attestations required, followed by Korean Embassy consular legalization in Islamabad or Apostille.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Korean translation for all non-English/non-Korean documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Dual submission: Online portal application followed by mandatory postal dispatch of certified physical dossier to POSTECH.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete Bachelor's / Master's degree certificates and transcripts with CGPA >= 3.30/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC, MoFA, and consular legalized by Korean Embassy Islamabad.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed on official POSTECH form detailing background, motivation, research interests, and career goals.
Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors submitted electronically.
IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 79+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.
Comprehensive academic CV detailing publications, research projects, technical skills, and awards.
Family Registration Certificate (FRC) and copies of passports of applicant and parents.

important_dates_timeline.document_submission_deadline: October 5 / April 5 (Hard copy postal arrival in Pohang)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Bi-annual intake: Spring semester starts in March, Fall semester starts in September.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior CGPA, academic rigor in engineering/science, university standing)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (Technical research capability, publications, programming skills, research proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of vision and alignment with POSTECH research priorities)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: POSTECH Departmental Admissions Committee, School Graduate Deans, and Admissions Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous holistic evaluation assessing mathematical ability, research productivity, experimental aptitude, and alignment with faculty laboratories.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,800 to 2,400 international applicants across both intakes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~120 to 180 fully funded international awards annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~12.0% to 15.0% for applicants with strong research profiles and CGPA >= 3.60
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate/Master's CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00, accompanied by strong programming skills or publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with exceptional academic records in computer science, engineering, or physics, documented project experience, and professor alignment.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (NUST, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore, GIKI, PIEAS, COMSATS, Quaid-i-Azam).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Vietnam, China, India, Indonesia, Turkey, Iran, Russia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portal adm-g.postech.ac.kr.
POSTECH does not work with third-party agents; all applications must be submitted directly by the candidate.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of USD 80 is paid directly through the secure POSTECH online portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Applications prepared by commercial agents are rejected; authentic personal statements and research experience are essential.
hidden_costs_breakdown: NADRA FRC and document attestations (HEC, MoFA, Korean Embassy): ~PKR 35,000 to 50,000.
DHL document courier to South Korea: ~PKR 12,000.
Initial living deposit before first stipend payment: ~KRW 500,000 (~PKR 105,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Korean TOPIK certificate is needed. Reality: 100% of graduate education at POSTECH is conducted in English.
Myth: Flights are included. Reality: Airfare to South Korea is self-funded by the student.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim POSTECH requires GRE; GRE is optional and not mandatory for international graduate admissions.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum semester GPA of 3.00 out of 4.30 to retain the fellowship and tuition waiver each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research presence at POSTECH campus; daily participation in laboratory research activities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual academic progress review evaluated by research advisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Off-campus employment is restricted under Korean immigration law; part-time work requires permission from immigration and university.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for Korean D-10 job seeker visas or E-7 professional engineering visas upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Tuition waiver is cancelled if semester GPA drops below 3.00 or if student is dismissed for disciplinary infractions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change requires approval from current advisor, new advisor, and department heads.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions beyond standard 4 semesters (Master's) or 8 semesters (PhD) are generally not covered by the scholarship.
